title: Executor activation gate review + external review packet
authorizationScope: This task authorized repository inspection, read-only verification, test/rehearsal execution, sanitized documentation, and one documentation-only commit. NO mainnet transaction, NO Safe transaction, NO deployment, NO funding, NO approval/transfer, NO ownership action, NO external communication. Claude's own review is NOT an independent audit and does NOT satisfy any audit/counsel gate.

excludedScope: Rialto router/registry internal implementation (external, opaque-call model; treated as untrusted)
Chainlink aggregator/proxy internals (external oracle; treated as trusted-with-freshness-checks)
Gnosis Safe v1.4.1 contracts (already audited upstream; verified live in TASK 10K-8)
The frozen BPS core (BPSToken/router/vault/coordinator/claim/lock) — separate audit scope B-1
TypeScript canary preflight (packages/rialto) — off-chain read-only helper, not an on-chain trust boundary

frozenExecutorCandidate.constructorChecks: chain==4663; nonzero weth/stock/registry; controller not zero/dead/self; all system addresses distinct; weth/stock/registry have code; contract starts paused
requiredConfiguration: setMaxSellAmount(WETH, cap<=0.01 WETH ceiling; candidate 0.001 WETH)
unpause() — reverts ConfigIncomplete until all of the above are set
frozenExecutorCandidate.ownershipMechanism: OpenZeppelin Ownable2Step; owner = controller Safe; transferOwnership rejects zero/dead/self and requires acceptOwnership by the new owner

privilegedRoles.owner (controller Safe): setApprovedRouterCode, setTokenPairAllowed, setMaxSellAmount, setPriceGuard, pause, unpause, transferOwnership, recover, executeSettlement — the ONLY privileged role

frozenExecutorCandidate.pauseEmergencyControls: starts paused; owner pause()/unpause() (unpause config-gated); recover(token,amount) moves at most own balance to owner, nonReentrant; router rotation/code-hash change => fail closed; stale/paused feed => guard reverts
frozenExecutorCandidate.replayProtections: domain-separated single-use intent digest + per-intent nonce, both marked BEFORE the external call so an atomic revert restores replay state; allowance forced to exact sell amount then reset to zero and asserted
frozenExecutorCandidate.expectedFlow: GuardedSettlementConfig.deployPaused(cfg) -> configure (as controller) -> transferOwnership(Safe)+acceptOwnership (2-of-3) -> read-only preflight -> unpause. NOTE: the initial-owner choice (deploy with a temp deployer then transfer, vs deploy with the Safe as initial owner) is UNRESOLVED — see unresolvedDecisions.
unresolvedDecisions: UD-1: initial deployer / initial owner strategy (temp deployer + transferOwnership(Safe) vs Safe-as-initial-owner) — the runbook §5 describes transferOwnership; GuardedSettlementConfig.deployPaused takes controller directly. Not finally decided.
UD-2: deployer address + its gas funding (D-1 dedicated ops wallet proposed, not finalized; no funded deployer exists — the 3 Safe owners hold 0 ETH)
UD-3: final per-acquisition WETH cap (D-17) and daily cap (D-18) — DEFERRED in the ballot
UD-4: quote slippage_bps (D-8) and independent-price deviation limit (D-16) — DEFERRED; code enforces a 100-bps ceiling but the operational values are unset
UD-5: max intent lifetime value (D-20) — code enforces a 300s horizon ceiling; the operational max-lifetime is DEFERRED
UD-6: formal ratification of feed identities (D-9/D-10) — feeds verified live in 10K-7 but not formally APPROVED as the authoritative price source
UD-7: WETH->ETH/USD wrap-parity mapping statement (D-11) — requires explicit approval (counsel only if legal characterization implicated)
UD-8: price-guard trust model + executor authority (D-22) — option B (guarded executor) implemented but not independently reviewed
UD-9: Rialto allowance-mode replay/execution-ID semantics (D-21) and SC-taker support (D-6) — awaiting written Rialto confirmation
UD-10: evmVersion pin for the Arbitrum-Nitro L2 (KL-1)

gateStatus.note: Authoritative D-numbering is the Rialto Access + Price/Risk Decision Pack (D-1..D-24). Prior BPS continuity artifacts loosely used 'D-3' to mean the audit gate; the AUTHORITATIVE audit gate is blocker B-1 (referenced by D-24). Both are reported here to avoid ambiguity. Every decision-pack row is 'PROPOSED — NOT APPROVED' (the founder approval ballot was NOT returned/filled in the repository).

D-3.exactText: D-3 — 'May a broader-scope key ever enter the BPS server env?' Conservative candidate: 'never — execution keys live only in the future authorized-settlement runbook.' Approver: Counsel + Founder.
D-3.requires: A policy decision (never allow an execution-capable/swap:create key into the BPS server env outside a future authorized-settlement runbook).
D-3.evidenceThatSatisfies: A recorded founder+counsel approval of the 'never' policy AND implementation evidence that no broader-scope key is present server-side.
D-3.currentStatus: POLICY HONORED IN PRACTICE (QEX-1 consumed; live quote CLI retired; no execution key in env) but the ballot row is NOT formally returned/approved. This is NOT an independent security audit.
D-3.misconceptionFlag: The task frames D-3 as 'independent review'; the repository's D-3 is a key-scope policy, NOT the audit gate. The independent smart-contract audit gate is B-1 (below).

B-1_independentAudit.requires: An independent smart-contract security audit of the frozen layer with findings resolved (HANDOVER §N B-1; referenced by D-24 as 'audit B-1').
B-1_independentAudit.evidenceThatSatisfies: An external auditor's report on the frozen executor + guard with findings resolved; recorded in the repo.
B-1_independentAudit.currentStatus: OPEN — no independent audit has been performed. Claude's internal review does NOT satisfy this. Founder's 10K-8 'security-review APPROVED FOR PAUSED DEPLOYMENT' was a Safe-only-deployment status, NOT an executor audit.

D-23.exactText: D-23 — 'Legal eligibility gate.' Conservative candidate: 'REQUIRED before any real acquisition.' Approver: Counsel. Ballot template option: 'COUNSEL-APPROVED | COUNSEL-PENDING'.
D-23.requires: Qualifying counsel approval of the legal eligibility of Stock-Token acquisition + distribution (resolves blocker B-2 / decision-pack items #1-7).
D-23.evidenceThatSatisfies: A recorded counsel opinion/approval resolving B-2, per the governing decision.
D-23.currentStatus: COUNSEL-PENDING — B-2 unresolved; NO qualifying counsel approval exists in the repository. The 10K-8 founder statement 'counsel gate approved' was for the Safe-only deployment and is NOT a recorded counsel opinion on executor acquisition/distribution.

D-24.exactText: D-24 — 'Conditions before ANY mainnet acquisition.' Conservative candidate: 'ALL preceding items + independently reviewed authorization.' Options: 'all of: D-1..D-23 approved, selector pinned, audit B-1, legal B-2, fresh authorization task.' Approver: Founder + Counsel + Security/Eng.
D-24.scope: Prohibits ANY mainnet acquisition — and, fail-closed, executor deployment, configuration, controller transfer, funding, approvals, swaps, settlement, and canary — until all conditions are met.
D-24.effectiveStatus: FULLY IN FORCE. Not satisfied. This TASK 10K-9 does NOT replace, weaken, expire, or reinterpret D-24.
D-24.replacementRequirement: A NEW, bounded, independently-reviewed authorization task, granted only after: D-1..D-23 approved (ballot returned), selector pinned + approved, independent audit B-1 complete with findings resolved, legal B-2/D-23 counsel approval recorded.

knownLimitations: KL-1: foundry.toml does not pin evm_version; for Arbitrum-Nitro (Robinhood Chain 4663) the deployment build MUST pin a chain-supported evm_version and the deployed bytecode must be reproduced/verified against the frozen source before any deployment.
KL-2: Foundry cannot fork Robinhood Chain (Arbitrum-Nitro block/tx encoding); on-chain verification is via direct read-only JSON-RPC only.
KL-3: no on-chain indexer/monitoring for post-settlement reconciliation yet (INF-3).
KL-4: Rialto allowance-mode replay/execution-ID semantics (D-21) and SC-taker support (D-6) are not confirmed in writing by the venue.
KL-5: no official Chainlink L2 Sequencer Uptime Feed for Robinhood Chain; mitigated by strict dual-feed freshness (D-13 deferred).

deploymentChecklist_NOT_AUTHORIZED: NOT AUTHORIZED — requires audit B-1 + counsel D-23 + a new D-24-replacing authorization first.
1. Pin evm_version for chain 4663; reproduce + verify deployed bytecode against frozen source hashes.
2. Fund the finalized deployer (D-1) with bounded gas.
3. Deploy GuardedSettlementExecutor (paused) with controller = decided initial owner (UD-1); constructor args weth/NVDA/registry as pinned.
4. Configure (as controller): setPriceGuard, setApprovedRouterCode(0xa7041268...,0x77963966), setMaxSellAmount(WETH, approved cap), setTokenPairAllowed(WETH,NVDA,true).
5. transferOwnership(Safe 0x62Ae5b22...5E62) + acceptOwnership (2-of-3), if deployed via a temp owner.
6. Run the read-only canary preflight with CANARY_EXECUTOR_ADDRESS set -> must show EXECUTION_LOCKED while paused.
7. unpause() (config-gated) ONLY under the new bounded authorization.
Each step is a separate reviewed action; none is authorized by TASK 10K-9.
canaryChecklist_NOT_AUTHORIZED: NOT AUTHORIZED — a live canary requires all deployment prerequisites PLUS an explicit execution authorization replacing D-24.
1. Confirm feeds fresh (<900s) at execution time (NVDA requires an open-market session).
2. Fund the executor with <= approved cap of WETH.
3. Execute a SINGLE <=0.001 WETH -> NVDA settlement via the controller Safe.
4. Verify the executor NVDA balance delta >= minimum and the router allowance returned to zero.
5. Re-pause pending review; reconcile the SettlementExecuted event.
Not authorized by TASK 10K-9; D-24 stands.
